parsed.title: Getting started
parsed.snippet:
H5P Guides

Create and store H5P Content on H5P.com

[Click here to get started](https://login.h5p.com/register?utm_source=h5porg&utm_medium=pageview&utm_campaign=getting-started)

H5P.com offers features like:

*   Hosting
*   LMS support

*   Embed H5P content into any page
*   Access H5P content through a direct link (no LMS required)
*   Content and user management and more.

[![](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/file-5afacb0236b77.png)](https://login.h5p.com/register?utm_source=h5porg&utm_medium=pageview&utm_campaign=getting-started)

H5P is supported by any VLE with LTI support like Canvas, Brightspace and Blackboard

[![](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/h5p/content/288324/images/file-5b62ca6f27d9a.png)](https://h5p.org/documentation/for-authors/h5p-for-canvas)

[![](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/h5p/content/288324/images/file-5b62ca69bfa0d.png)](https://h5p.org/documentation/for-authors/h5p-for-brightspace)

[![](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/h5p/content/288324/images/file-5b62ca64426e8.png)](https://h5p.org/documentation/for-authors/h5p-for-blackboard)

H5P for programmers and self-hosters

H5P is also available for programmers and professional self-hosters as a plugin for the below publishing systems. The plugin has fewer features and no support included, but is fully customize-able for programmers and possible to host behind firewalls etc.

  

[![](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/moodle-logo.png)](https://h5p.org/integrations#plugins)

[![](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/wordpress-logo.png)](https://h5p.org/integrations#plugins)

[![](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/drupal-logo.png)](https://h5p.org/integrations#plugins)

**Other things you might want to do:**  

[![](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/editor_2.png)](https://h5p.org/testdrive-h5p)

Try out the H5P authoring tool  
H5P empowers everyone to create, share and reuse interactive content. We've made a selection of interactive content types available for testing here on H5P.org.

[Test drive the authoring tool](https://h5p.org/testdrive-h5p)

To get some guidance on creating H5P content, take a look at the [tutorials](https://h5p.org/documentation/for-authors/tutorials) in the [content author guide](https://h5p.org/documentation/for-authors/).


Develop new content types  
If you are a developer familiar with JavaScript and other related web technologies, we suggest you do the following:

1.  Install a CMS and an H5P plugin for that CMS. Currently, the easiest way is to download [Drupal](https://drupal.org/project/drupal) and the [H5P Drupal plugin](https://drupal.org/project/h5p). The Drupal plugin has some extra development features that the other plugins don't have.
2.  Complete our ["Hello world tutorial](https://h5p.org/tutorial-greeting-card)"
3.  Look at the [H5P examples](https://h5p.org/content-types-and-applications)
4.  Get familiar with the [developer guide](https://h5p.org/developers)
5.  Create new libraries using your newly acquired H5P skills
6.  [Share](https://h5p.org/getting-involved) your work here at H5P.org!


Improve existing H5P content types  
The code for the H5P content types are shared on [GitHub](https://github.com/h5p).

Designers and developers are encouraged to improve these content types by:

1.  Setting up your H5P development environment using the [installation and setup guide](https://h5p.org/installation).
2.  Downloading H5P libraries from the [examples and download page](https://h5p.org/content-types-and-applications) or our [GitHub](https://github.com/h5p) repository.
3.  Extending or modifying the library.
4.  Sharing your improvements on our [forum](https://h5p.org/forum/2) and submitting a [pull request](https://help.github.com/articles/using-pull-requests/) on GitHub!

H5P Guides

# Getting started

 H5P is a plugin for existing publishing systems that enables the system to create interactive content like [Interactive Videos](https://h5p.org/interactive-video), [Presentations](https://h5p.org/presentation), [Games](https://h5p.org/memory-game), [Quizzes](https://h5p.org/question-set) and [more](https://h5p.org/content-types-and-applications)!

Create and store H5P Content on H5P.com

[Click here to get started](https://login.h5p.com/register?utm_source=h5porg&utm_medium=pageview&utm_campaign=getting-started)

H5P.com offers features like:

*   Hosting
*   LMS support
*       *   Embed H5P content into any page
    *   Access H5P content through a direct link (no LMS required)
    *   Content and user management and more.

[![Image 11](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/file-5afacb0236b77.png)](https://login.h5p.com/register?utm_source=h5porg&utm_medium=pageview&utm_campaign=getting-started)

 H5P is supported by any VLE with LTI support like Canvas, Brightspace and Blackboard

[![Image 12](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/h5p/content/288324/images/file-5b62ca6f27d9a.png)](https://h5p.org/documentation/for-authors/h5p-for-canvas)

[![Image 13](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/h5p/content/288324/images/file-5b62ca69bfa0d.png)](https://h5p.org/documentation/for-authors/h5p-for-brightspace)

[![Image 14](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/h5p/content/288324/images/file-5b62ca64426e8.png)](https://h5p.org/documentation/for-authors/h5p-for-blackboard)

[More integrations](https://h5p.org/integrations#integrations)

The development of H5P is funded by the income from H5P.com. We encourage you to try out [H5P.com](https://h5p.com/?utm_source=h5porg&utm_medium=pageview&utm_campaign=getting-started) and support the H5P development.

H5P for programmers and self-hosters

H5P is also available for programmers and professional self-hosters as a plugin for the below publishing systems. The plugin has fewer features and no support included, but is fully customize-able for programmers and possible to host behind firewalls etc.

[![Image 15](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/moodle-logo.png)](https://h5p.org/integrations#plugins)

[![Image 16](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/wordpress-logo.png)](https://h5p.org/integrations#plugins)

[![Image 17](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/drupal-logo.png)](https://h5p.org/integrations#plugins)

[More plugins](https://h5p.org/integrations#plugins)

**Other things you might want to do:**

[![Image 18](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/editor_2.png)](https://h5p.org/testdrive-h5p)

Try out the H5P authoring tool

H5P empowers everyone to create, share and reuse interactive content. We've made a selection of interactive content types available for testing here on H5P.org.

[Test drive the authoring tool](https://h5p.org/testdrive-h5p)

 To get some guidance on creating H5P content, take a look at the [tutorials](https://h5p.org/documentation/for-authors/tutorials) in the [content author guide](https://h5p.org/documentation/for-authors/). 


Develop new content types

 If you are a developer familiar with JavaScript and other related web technologies, we suggest you do the following: 
1.   Install a CMS and an H5P plugin for that CMS. Currently, the easiest way is to download[Drupal](https://drupal.org/project/drupal)and the[H5P Drupal plugin](https://drupal.org/project/h5p). The Drupal plugin has some extra development features that the other plugins don't have.
2.   Complete our["Hello world tutorial](https://h5p.org/tutorial-greeting-card)"
3.   Look at the[H5P examples](https://h5p.org/content-types-and-applications)
4.   Get familiar with the[developer guide](https://h5p.org/developers)
5.   Create new libraries using your newly acquired H5P skills
6.   [Share](https://h5p.org/getting-involved)your work here at H5P.org!


Improve existing H5P content types

 The code for the H5P content types are shared on [GitHub](https://github.com/h5p).

 Designers and developers are encouraged to improve these content types by: 
1.   Setting up your H5P development environment using the [installation and setup guide](https://h5p.org/installation).
2.   Downloading H5P libraries from the [examples and download page](https://h5p.org/content-types-and-applications)or our [GitHub](https://github.com/h5p)repository.
3.   Extending or modifying the library.
4.   Sharing your improvements on our [forum](https://h5p.org/forum/2)and submitting a [pull request](https://help.github.com/articles/using-pull-requests/) on GitHub!

[![Image 21](https://h5p.org/sites/default/files/plugins.png)](https://h5p.org/developers#new-plugin)

Integrate H5P with a new platform

We've focused on the documentation for H5P content types and applications so far. We've started on[docs for plugin creation](https://h5p.org/developers#new-plugin)as well.

[Read more about getting involved in developing H5P.](https://h5p.org/getting-involved)

### [It is possible to do that, but not at all easy](https://h5p.org/comment/716#comment-716)

It shouldn't limit the data the H5P will send back to Moodle, but it won't be possible to automatically update the content and hence it won't be easy to add new features for instance the xAPI integration that is coming up. With xAPI a lot more data will be available for Moodle.

It isn't a catastrophic aproach, but I think we're better of if the resources for doing this is spent on either helping us finishing the Moodle integration for H5P or making an HTML export in H5P core(?) :)

# Getting started

 H5P is a plugin for existing publishing systems that enables the system to create interactive content like [Interactive Videos](https://h5p.org/interactive-video), [Presentations](https://h5p.org/presentation), [Games](https://h5p.org/memory-game), [Quizzes](https://h5p.org/question-set) and [more](https://h5p.org/content-types-and-applications)!

Create and store H5P Content on H5P.com
